research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ultima Genomics is researching and developing optimized sequencing systems and methods, including approaches for sequencing nucleic acid samples, use of ethylene carbonate in nucleic acid sequencing methods, nucleic acid molecule sequencing systems and methods, and systems, methods, and compositions for sequencing. Their work also covers methods for sequencing error correction via double strand analysis and methylation sequencing methods and compositions, highlighting advancements in low-cost sequencing platforms.

Ultima Genomics is unleashing the power of genomics at scale. Ultima Genomics drives the scale of genomic information to enable unprecedented advances in biology and improvements in human health.

The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Newark, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Ultima Genomics is a developer of a low-cost sequencing platform.

product.name: UG200 Series
product.description: A high-throughput sequencing platform offering 5B, 10B, and 20B wafer outputs for scalable genomic data generation, with automated operation and configurations for single- or dual-wafer sequencing.

product.name: UG 100 Sequencing Platform
product.description: A high-throughput next-generation sequencing instrument based on Ultima’s sequencing architecture, designed to generate genomic data at lower cost for whole-genome, single-cell, cancer, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic studies.

product.name: Solaris 2.0
product.description: A library-preparation workflow using specialized primers or adapters for Ultima sequencing, designed to improve coverage of challenging genomic regions while remaining compatible with selected third-party preparation providers.

product.name: ppmSeq™
product.description: A paired plus-minus sequencing workflow for highly accurate dual-strand DNA sequencing, supporting low-frequency single-nucleotide variant detection in applications such as liquid biopsy and minimal residual disease analysis.

product.name: Analysis and Bioinformatics
product.description: A suite of preconfigured secondary-analysis pipelines and integrated computing resources for processing Ultima sequencing data at the read and sample levels.

product.name: Solaris Free and Solaris Flex
product.description: Library-preparation options for Ultima sequencing that provide alternative workflow configurations for generating sequencing libraries across different research applications and laboratory requirements.
